phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F8 Phase A — Other Accounts Coverage Audit
purpose: Determine exact ECB QSA who-to-whom coverage for total F8, including exact cell-level recovery as F81+F89 where total F8 is not directly disseminated, and independently test the same decomposition at aggregate-control level.

instrument_boundary.F89: Other accounts receivable/payable excluding trade credits and advances
instrument_boundary.rule: F81 must never be used as a substitute for F8.

source_orientations.domestic_holder_asset: W2; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=issuer; entry=A
source_orientations.domestic_issuer_liability: W2; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=holder; entry=L
source_orientations.resident_holder_to_X: W1; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=S1; entry=A
source_orientations.X_holder_to_resident_issuer: W1; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=S1; entry=L

source_dimensions.custom_breakdown: _T total only; direct-investment FND must not replace total

promotion_rule: A later F8 rank/materialization gate may use a cell only if total F8 is directly observed or exactly derived as F81+F89 with all required source terms available, no orientation/subinstrument conflict, and accounting controls satisfied. This phase only records source coverage.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery. No behavioural feedback, delay, nonlinearity or closure status may change.
